About the Role

Join a machine learning team focused on improving large language model efficiency and quality. You will help develop and evaluate approaches that reduce token usage while maintaining strong output quality.

What You'll Do

  • Experiment with language model configurations to identify optimization opportunities.

  • Build and maintain data pipelines for model training and evaluation workflows.

  • Analyze performance metrics to assess model quality and efficiency.

  • Contribute to internal tools that monitor and optimize model behavior.

  • Follow current machine learning and language model research and apply relevant findings to product improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • A degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on experience building or training machine learning models with Python and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.

  • Knowledge of machine learning, statistics, model evaluation, and optimization techniques.

  • Familiarity with large language models, natural language processing, and prompt design or tuning.

  • Experience building machine learning data pipelines and analyzing model performance metrics.

  • Experience contributing to tools or monitoring systems for tracking model performance is helpful.

Location

Remote, full-time.
